lead.question: 刚买下的酒馆为何急着转手？五只空威士忌瓶真是鬼喝的吗？
lead.warmup: 伊恩·汤普森先生刚买下一家小酒店，转眼就挂牌出售，理由是屋里闹鬼：夜里酒吧传来怪声，第二天门被椅子堵住、家具被挪位，关掉的灯却亮着，还多了五只空威士忌酒瓶。可“我”暗示这可能是村民进来喝免费酒留下的，汤普森只是摇头。
goals: 掌握 must have done 对过去作肯定推测，并区分 must do 与 must have done
掌握 suggest 表“暗示/表明”与“建议”时接 that 从句的不同用法
运用 be up for sale、be haunted、give away、shake one's head、block、furniture 等搭配
复习 hear sb. doing、even if 让步从句与间接引语中 last night → the night before 的转换
lead.summary: 课文用一则幽默的“鬼故事”串起过去完成与情态推测：汤普森因“闹鬼”要卖酒馆，列举门被堵、家具移位、灯亮着、五只空威士忌瓶四项证据；叙述者却用 must have come in for a free drink 给出更接地气的解释，被摇头否定——村民连白送都不肯要。
lead.tips: must 表推测时，对现在用 must do，对过去用 must have done；感官动词 hear/see 后接 doing 强调“正在进行”。

questions.q: What evidence is there of a ghost?
questions.zh: 有什么证据表明那里有鬼？
questions.a: The doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved; though the lights had been turned off before he went to bed, they were on in the morning; and he found five empty whisky bottles which the ghost must have drunk the night before.
questions.aZh: 酒吧的门被椅子堵住、家具被挪动过；临睡前关掉的灯早晨却亮着；他还发现了五只空的威士忌酒瓶，据说是鬼魂头天晚上喝的。

questions.q: Why is Mr. Thompson going to sell the pub so soon after buying it?
questions.zh: 汤普森先生为什么刚买下这家小酒店就要把它卖掉？
questions.a: Because it is haunted. He could not go to sleep one night because he heard a strange noise coming from the bar.
questions.aZh: 因为那里闹鬼。有天夜里他听到酒吧里传来奇怪的响声，怎么也睡不着。

questions.q: What did the writer suggest, and how did Mr. Thompson react?
questions.zh: 作者暗示了什么？汤普森先生又是如何反应的？
questions.a: The writer suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink, but Mr. Thompson shook his head.
questions.aZh: 作者暗示说一定是有些村民进来喝了不花钱的酒，汤普森先生摇了摇头表示不同意。

questions.q: Why won't the villagers take the pub even if it is free?
questions.zh: 为什么即使酒馆白送，村民们也不肯要？
questions.a: Because they believe it is haunted. They have told him that they will not accept the pub even if he gives it away.
questions.aZh: 因为他们相信那里闹鬼。村民们已经告诉他，即使他把小酒店白送人，他们也不会接受。

questions.q: Do you think the pub is really haunted? Give your reasons based on the text.
questions.zh: 你认为这家酒馆真的闹鬼吗？请结合课文细节说明理由。
questions.a: Probably not. Blocked doors, moved furniture, lights left on and five empty whisky bottles look more like human visitors helping themselves to a free drink. But the villagers refuse the pub even when it is free, which keeps the mystery open.
questions.aZh: 很可能不是。堵门、挪家具、灯亮着和五只空酒瓶更像是有人进来白喝酒留下的痕迹；但村民连白送都不肯要，故事因此留下悬念。
questions.hint: 把“鬼证据”与末句“村民拒收”对照推断。

exercises.q: 根据课文填空：The next morning, he found that the doors had been _______ by chairs and the _______ had been moved.
根据课文填空：He found five empty _______ bottles, so the _______ was _______, not hungry.
翻译：最近被伊恩·汤普森先生买下的那家小酒店现在要出售，因为它闹鬼。
exercises.a: A public house which was recently bought by Mr. Ian Thompson is up for sale because it is haunted.

exercises.q: 改写为对过去作肯定推测的句子：The ghost drank the whisky. → The ghost _______ _______ _______ the whisky.
用 suggest 翻译：我暗示说一定是有些村民进来喝了不花钱的酒。
exercises.a: I suggested that some villagers must have come in for a free drink.
exercises.note: suggest 表“暗示”时从句不虚拟。

exercises.q: 合并句子：He heard a strange noise. It came from the bar. → He heard a strange noise _______ from the bar.
翻译：汤普森先生摇了摇头，说即使他把小酒店白送人，村民们也不会接受。
exercises.a: Mr. Thompson shook his head and said the villagers would not accept the pub even if he gave it away.

quiz.q: 汤普森先生为什么要把小酒店卖掉？
options: Because the pub is too small
Because it is haunted
Because he has moved to another village
Because no one comes to the bar

quiz.q: 第二天早上，汤普森先生发现了什么？
options: All the whisky bottles were broken
The doors had been blocked by chairs and the furniture had been moved
The bar was on fire
The lights had been stolen

quiz.q: “早上灯都亮着”正确的英文表达是？
options: They were on in the morning
They were opened in the morning
They were lighting in the morning
They were turned up in the morning
quiz.note: on 形容词表示“开着的”。

quiz.q: “这肯定是鬼魂头天晚上喝的”，空格处应填？
options: the ghost must drink
the ghost must have drunk
the ghost had drunk
the ghost would drink
Some villagers must have come in for a free drink
Mr. Thompson himself must have drunk the whisky
The ghost must be thirsty again tonight
The pub must be sold at once

quiz.q: 村民们对白送的酒馆持什么态度？
options: They will accept it gladly
They will buy it at a low price
They will not accept it even if he gives it away
They will turn it into a museum
